methodology.observation_window_basis: Window starts at the latest successful immutable run's window_end and ends at the current observation cutoff for the scheduled occurrence.
methodology.ranking_basis: Signal strength rather than popularity, emphasizing difficult-to-reverse commercialization, deployment, manufacturing, infrastructure, strategic transactions, regulatory progress, and meaningful technical milestones.
methodology.source_policy: Prefer primary company, government, regulatory, and research-institution sources; use originating-company releases distributed by reputable wire services when a direct primary page is unavailable.
methodology.repeat_policy: Canonical event fingerprints were checked; repeated events are included only for material updates with preserved event_key and material_update_from.
excluded_noise: market-price movement without underlying technical or commercial change

provenance.notes: Publication-request branch handoff; legacy history and longitudinal visual were not used.

findings.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Sol with near-Astra performance at materially lower API cost
findings.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol for complex coding, computer use, and professional work, with standard API pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens and support for multi-agent delegation in beta.
findings.why_it_matters: A substantial reduction in the cost of high-capability agentic inference expands the set of software, computer-use, and professional workflows that can economically run persistent or multi-agent systems.
findings.trend_statement: Frontier-class agent capabilities are moving down the inference-cost curve while becoming easier to compose into multi-agent workflows.

findings.headline: AMD agrees to acquire World Labs for approximately $8.2 billion
findings.summary: AMD entered a definitive all-stock agreement to acquire World Labs, the spatial-intelligence AI research company led by Fei-Fei Li, bringing model research in interactive 3D environments, robotic learning, and simulation into AMD.
findings.why_it_matters: The transaction moves AMD beyond supplying compute into direct model research and compute-model co-design for spatial intelligence and physical AI.
findings.trend_statement: AI infrastructure vendors are integrating frontier model research to shape hardware, software, and systems around emerging physical-AI workloads.

source_links.title: AMD to Acquire World Labs to Advance the Future of AI Compute

findings.headline: Lilly reports phase 3 retatrutide results showing 20.8% average weight loss in obesity with type 2 diabetes
findings.summary: In TRIUMPH-2, participants with obesity and type 2 diabetes receiving retatrutide 12 mg lost an average 49.6 pounds, or 20.8% of body weight, over 80 weeks; more than half no longer met BMI criteria for obesity.
findings.why_it_matters: A late-stage triple-agonist therapy producing weight loss of this magnitude in a diabetes population raises the demonstrated efficacy ceiling for metabolic medicines and advances a new mechanism toward regulatory submission.
findings.trend_statement: Next-generation multi-receptor metabolic drugs are extending the efficacy frontier established by GLP-1 therapies.

source_links.title: Lilly's triple agonist retatrutide delivered substantial weight loss and A1C reduction

findings.headline: Samsung affiliates commit $1 billion to Helix Digital Infrastructure
findings.summary: Samsung Electronics and five affiliates announced a combined $1 billion investment in Helix Digital Infrastructure, which is designed to integrate hyperscale data centers, power generation, transmission and distribution, and fiber infrastructure.
findings.why_it_matters: The investment ties a major semiconductor, construction, data-center, cooling, and battery ecosystem directly to integrated AI infrastructure build-out, reinforcing the trend toward vertically coordinated compute-and-power capacity.
findings.trend_statement: AI infrastructure investment is broadening from servers and chips into coordinated data-center, power, transmission, cooling, and fiber systems.

source_links.title: Samsung To Invest USD 1 Billion in AI Infrastructure Company Helix

findings.headline: U.S. Army selects Navitas to develop a domestic 10 kV silicon-carbide manufacturing process
findings.summary: Navitas Semiconductor received the Army Research Laboratory-sponsored ALATTIS prototype program to develop, execute, and validate a currently unavailable domestic manufacturing process for ultra-high-voltage 10 kV silicon-carbide IGBTs and associated PiN diode technologies.
findings.why_it_matters: A validated domestic 10 kV SiC process would extend U.S. manufacturing capability for high-power defense and critical-infrastructure electronics and reduce reliance on non-domestic ultra-high-voltage supply chains.
findings.trend_statement: Strategic power-electronics investment is pushing domestic silicon-carbide manufacturing toward higher-voltage defense and infrastructure applications.

source_links.title: U.S. Government Selects Navitas to Develop Next-Generation 10 kV SiC Power Semiconductors

evidence.evidence_summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol with near-Astra capability at materially lower API pricing.
AMD agreed to acquire World Labs to integrate spatial-intelligence model research with its AI compute roadmap.
Samsung affiliates committed $1 billion to an integrated AI infrastructure platform spanning data centers and power.

category_assessments.justification: The window combines cheaper frontier-class agentic inference, major vertical integration of spatial-AI research, and additional billion-dollar AI infrastructure capital formation.
No new aerospace or space development inside this observation window cleared the materiality threshold without repeating the September 28 Starship event.

evidence.evidence_summary: World Labs develops spatial-intelligence models and technology for robotic learning and simulation, and AMD agreed to acquire the company.

category_assessments.justification: World Labs brings spatial-intelligence and robotic-learning research directly into a major compute platform strategy, strengthening the physical-AI development stack.

evidence.evidence_summary: The Army-sponsored ALATTIS program targets development and validation of a domestic 10 kV SiC manufacturing process.

category_assessments.justification: ALATTIS targets a currently unavailable domestic manufacturing capability for ultra-high-voltage silicon-carbide power devices.

evidence.evidence_summary: Samsung's Helix investment explicitly targets integrated power generation, transmission and distribution alongside hyperscale data centers.
ALATTIS targets 10 kV SiC power devices for critical defense and infrastructure applications.

category_assessments.justification: The window adds capital and component-development signals aimed directly at AI power infrastructure and high-voltage power conversion, though neither represents new operating generation capacity yet.
No new transportation development inside this observation window cleared the materiality threshold.

evidence.evidence_summary: Lilly's phase 3 TRIUMPH-2 trial reported 20.8% average weight loss at the 12 mg retatrutide dose in people with obesity and type 2 diabetes.

category_assessments.justification: The phase 3 result materially raises the demonstrated efficacy frontier for multi-receptor metabolic therapy in a difficult diabetes-and-obesity population.

AMD's World Labs acquisition strengthens compute-model co-design for spatial and physical AI.
Samsung affiliates committed $1 billion to integrated data-center, power, transmission, and fiber infrastructure through Helix.
